description:
There is a 42 x 51 x 63 mm large extra-axial dural based high convexity frontal mass with multiple cystic components in the right side.

Areas of marked restriction on DWI images (solid component) are seen.

Marked vasogenic edematous changes and mass effect on the ipsilateral frontal horn are also noted.

No evidence of obvious midline shift and subfalcine herniation is depicted.
